# r/place agent index

An Organizational Fruit Fly: a frozen dataset and a revisable instrument for cumulative grounded theory.

## Research context

- [Model organisms across fields](guides/model-organisms.md).
- [One shared research object](guides/project.md).
- [Common conditions](conditions.md).
- [The whole event](event.md).
- [Shared data and tools](tools.md).

> Use these reading keys to find the authoritative instrument. They do not replace it.

[Start here](agents.md). Use [resolved source links](reading/manifest.json); exact source bytes and hashes remain in [sources/manifest.json](sources/manifest.json).

## Results

- [Read the completed study](results.md): PlaceNL and the population model.
- [PlaceNL coding](results/data/case.md), [timeline](results/data/timeline.md), [A1 note](results/data/a1-note.md), [local R6 model](results/data/R6-model.md), and [all return decisions](results/data/return-decisions.json).
- [Population model](results/data/MODEL-D3.md), [served ladder](results/data/LADDER.md), and [all community profiles](results/data/population-rows.csv).

## Handlers, in order

1. [Collection handler, new](agents/collection.md): Prepare the data.
2. [Existing coding handler reading key](agents/communities.md): Code communities.
3. [Existing aggregator handler reading key](agents/aggregator.md): Run the aggregator.

## Checkpoint interviews

- [Checkpoint catalogue](catalog.json): The baseline publication census, not a live agent.
- [Dated historical context](guides/history.md) and [evidence map](history.json): Later verified closes, actual model settings, fork lineage and instruction amendments. Read these with the baseline catalogue.
- [Interview runtime](runtime.md): An interview is an audit copy. Never update the original run, infer missing files from the latest workspace, or substitute a fresh agent when native restoration fails.
